notes.title: What to Expect in V0.21
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]The upcoming [b]V0.21 update [/b]will bring a [b]massive amount[/b] [b]of new content[/b] and features to the game.
From fresh gameplay mechanics to new scenes and long-requested changes and expansions, this update is packed with improvements inspired directly by community feedback.[/p][p]It should be available here on Steam in about 3–4 weeks, as soon as translations are updated and final bug testing is done.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Quest[/h3][p][b]King of Nothing[/b] [i](Mainquest)[/i]
It's time to finally face Ava. The stage is set for the ultimate showdown between the MC and the woman who has haunted him for so long. But are you strong enough to resist her influence once and for all and take control of your own destiny?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/8ffd80d77de57aa0ac8cc4cd8ac7b6aa18b82c72.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Home Expansion[/h3][p]You can now build a [b]second basement level[/b] beneath your home! This new area allows you to create [b]private rooms[/b] for each of your girls, as well as an [b]Ascension Room[/b] and even an [b]indoor pool with a spa zone.[/b][/p][p]All of this is managed through the newly revamped Real Estate app.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/1776f823b0a99761ae9fe29740ee0fe81ba336f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/c1feea92a11200ce4c4587244d1b068a6529913d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Reworked "Girls at home" feature[/h3][p]Alongside the home expansion, the "[b]Girls at Home"[/b] feature has been completely reworked![/p][p]From now on, if you want a girl to live in your home, you'll first need to build her a [b]personal room[/b]. The number of [b]Harem Quarters[/b] you've constructed determines how many girls can stay with you at once. The good news, there's [b]no upper limit[/b]![/p][p]Also, girls who live with you are no longer restricted to staying inside your home. From now on, girls who live with you will either go about their regular daily routines or remain at home. That will be decided randomly.[/p][p]And one more important update:
[b]Pregnant girls[/b] and [b]drones[/b] will now also remain inside your home. Instead of leaving, they'll withdraw to their private rooms, where you can always visit them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/6e03c98e2776ca94cbab7277d0c9796b742ad699.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New scenes at home[/h3][p]But that's not all! To go along with the home rework, I've added a total of [b]18 new scenes[/b] that can be experienced [b]with the girls living in your house[/b]. Each girl gets [b]1 or 2 new scenes[/b], and yes, [b]two threesomes[/b] are included as well!
The scenes cover a wide range of content… and every single one of them is [b]fully animated[/b].[/p][p]With the exception of Sofia and Chloe, every girl who can currently live with you has received at least one new scene in this update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/ce57d384d9da7b6fd506c37a8ec623a3c40e7e57.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/30eac6f548a3ba1805a3fb7db3d745281248a022.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Upgrade harem members and the MC[/h3][p]The new [b]Harem Quarters[/b] serve as private living spaces for your girls, the Indoor Pool unlocks new scenes. And the Ascension Room? That's where things get really interesting. In the [b]Ascension Room[/b], you can [b]upgrade both yourself and your harem members[/b]!
Each girl has [b]three powerful upgrade options[/b] to choose from. These upgrades come at a price, though, each one requires a significant amount of Mind Points. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/13820572303ee7a4c631f1fd3b87e2c70cc4764e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Quality of Life improvements[/h3][p]The "[b]Harem"[/b] tab in your [b]Contacts app[/b] has received a big usability upgrade. There you now can see who's currently living in your home, whether someone is pregnant, how far along the pregnancy is, and what personality state each girl currently is in.[/p][p]I've also added [b]character portraits to the locations on the World Map[/b], for both main and side[b] girls[/b]. These portraits show you whether you've already completed a location, or if there's still someone you've missed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/c43f33deb89d28f2b65f0cda31e6a33f841b7c28.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Lovense support added[/h3][p]With V0.21, Lovense toys are now fully supported, bringing a whole new level of immersion to every scene.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V0.20 update out now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]V0.20 of Shattered Minds is now live on Steam![/b][/p][p][b]V0.20 [/b]focuses entirely on[b] Zoe, [/b]a character brought to life with the[b] help of the community.[/b]
From her body type and hairstyle to the central theme of her story, [b]bimbofication[/b], every major detail was chosen via polls.[/p][p]This update also introduces a brand-new side character: [b]Amaia[/b]. You can meet her at the mall.
On top of that, the world of [i]Shattered Minds[/i] has expanded once again with a new building: [b]the Diner.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Content of V0.20 (Changelog):[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Role Models[/b] [i](Zoe – Quest 1):[/i] You meet Zoe and quickly sense the inner conflict beneath her calm exterior. Deep down, she's yearning for change. All she needs is someone who believes in her... and gives her a little push in the right direction.
[i]*Click on her in the gym's spa to start her questline.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Idolatry of Beauty[/b] [i](Zoe – Quest 2):[/i] The MC begins to subtly guide Zoe toward the idea of "improving" herself. It starts small; a new hair color, a sun-kissed tan... but it quickly becomes clear: [b]Zoe wants more[/b]. Her desire to become the perfect version of herself begins to spiral into something much bigger… and much hotter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blooming Flower[/b] [i](Zoe – Quest 3): [/i]Encouraged by the MC, Zoe takes the next step: [b]plastic surgery.[/b] Piece by piece, she sculpts her body into the woman she's always dreamed of being. And once her outer transformation is complete, the final stage begins, shaping her mind to match her new self.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New harem member: Zoe
[/b]Zoe will become regular members of your harem, with new scenes available for her at your home and at the gym. She can get pregnant and will be able to move into your house.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Smartphone Wallpaper: Zoe[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New side character: Amaia: [/b]You'll find her working as a janitor at the local mall. Amaia features fully animated scenes, and once she's corrupted, you'll unlock a unique gameplay bonus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New location: Diner: [/b]First introduced in Rose's quest, the Diner will now be available as a full, visitable location. You'll also be able to purchase it and add it to your expanding real estate empire.[/p][/*][*][p]bug fixes, rebalancing and spelling corrections[/p][/*][/list]

Her desire to become the perfect version of herself begins to spiral into something much bigger… and much hotter.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blooming Flower[/b] [i](Zoe – Quest 3)[/i]

She can get pregnant and will be able to move into your house.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780341/29482d86bdfc028053836f6e48777d55fc2c01eb.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]New Side Character: Amaia[/h3][p]With [b]Amaia[/b], a new side character joins the game! In addition to being a place for new encounters and upcoming quests, the Diner can also be [b]purchased[/b] and become part of your ever-growing [b]real estate empire[/b].[/p]

notes.title: What to Expect in V0.19
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

The V0.19 update has entered its final beta testing stage, and all translations are currently in progress! It should be available here on Steam in about 3–4 weeks. Here's what you can look forward to:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G3sT1SM.jpeg[/img]

[h3]New Quests[/h3]

[b]Home is Where the Heart is Frozen (Main Quest):[/b] Driven by Ava's looming attempt to take over your body, you embark on a trip to the snowy mountains of Canada to find Francesca, a powerful woman with the rare ability to nullify the powers of others. You need her in your harem!

[b]Sweet Temptation with a Chainsaw (Rose):[/b] Dive into a humorous and slightly twisted adventure with the eccentric Rose. Can you manage to break into her mind and reshape her quirky, twisted personality?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UdVXoLd.jpeg[/img]

[h3]New harem member: Francesca & Rose[/h3]

Both Francesca and Rose will become regular members of your harem, with new scenes available for Francesca at your home and for Rose in her apartment. Both girls can get pregnant, but only Francesca will be able to move into your house.

[h3]Side Characters ReDesign[/h3]

Starting with V0.19, all currently available Side Characters will now feature animations! Also, fully corrupted Side Characters will offer you passive bonuses. You can always see which bonus each character provides under their corruption status, even if they haven't been fully corrupted yet. This allows you to strategically choose which one to focus on first.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bLzcNjq.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: V0.18 update out now!
notes.notes:
[b]V0.18 of Shattered Minds is now available on Steam![/b]

June awaits you in the [b]V0.18 update![/b] Unravel her personal and family struggles across three emotional quests, and help her rise as the new head of the gym—making both her and the gym part of your domain.

[b]Two new Side Characters[/b] join the game, and the "Girls at Home" feature now supports up to [b]8 girls![/b] Plus: [b]Russian [/b]is now available as a language option!

[h3]Content of V0.18 (Changelog):[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Striving for more (June): [/b]June's first quest starts when you talk to her in the open world. Spark June's ambition and guide her toward taking a leadership role at the gym—one that aligns perfectly with your goals.

[*][b]Family troubles (June):[/b] June's ambition for a leadership role at the gym clashes with her parents' expectations for her future. Torn between guilt, duty, and her true passion, she struggles to find balance. Help her resolve this conflict so she stays on the "right" path.

[*][b]The new manageress (June):[/b] With June's family issues resolved, it's time to focus on bringing the gym under yours and June's control. Some new exciting rules await! But there's one obstacle left, its current manager…

[*][b]New harem member:[/b] June becomes a regular member of your harem, with scenes available in the gym and at home. She can also move into your house and become pregnant if you choose.

[*][b]New Smartphone Wallpaper: June[/b]

[*][b]New side characters: Jennifer & Lillie:[/b] Jennifer is the one who helps you get in touch with Derrick during Mary's quest. Once you own the college, she'll be waiting outside the changing rooms—ready for a talk about her drug problem. Lillie appears after you take over the gym. As her trainer, you guide her through some… very hands-on workout routines.

[*][b]New Buildings to acquire; Gym & Chinese restaurant:[/b] Once June is part of your harem, you can buy the gym and enforce your own rules of conduct. Another building you can purchase is a non-visitable Chinese restaurant.

[*][b]Quality of Life change; Girls at Home – Extended:[/b] The limit has doubled—you can now host 8 women instead of 4.

[*][b]Translations:[/b] All translations have been updated and [b]Russian[/b] has been added as a new language option.

[*]bug fixes, rebalancing and spelling corrections
[/list]
